Casagrande succeeded Skempton, holding the presidency from 1961 to 1965. A steering committee was established in 1981, and it became the Board in 1985. This meets annually; the Council meets every two years. The current name, the International Society for Soil Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering, was adopted in 1997. ISSMGE membership has increased through its history.
